name: cache-assistant
description: Understand and control your Claude Code prompt-cache window: a live band above the prompt (tier, countdown, advice, one-press keep-alive), cache-expiry and model-switch guards that only interrupt for large re-writes, a statusline, and a tier-aware keep-alive.

block_threshold_tokens.title: Large re-write threshold (tokens)
block_threshold_tokens.description: A cold cache re-write of at least this many tokens counts as large: the guards block the first send once and the band advises against just continuing. Below it nothing blocks and the band says to keep going. 0 always blocks.

keepalive_max_pings.title: Keep-alive ping limit
keepalive_max_pings.description: The band's keep-alive switches itself off after this many pings without a message from you (about a dozen pings cost one cold re-write).
